notes.title: Input / controls update and playtests
notes.content:
[p]We spent the last two weeks completely reworking our [b]input system[/b]. This was something we pinpointed after analyzing your feedback from the [b]demo survey[/b] - for which we're super grateful!

The input system now works with both [b]mouse/keyboard[/b] and [b]gamepad[/b] devices (which also means SteamDeck compatibility). We implemented a [b]virtual mouse[/b] for gamepads, along with many quality-of-life features like arrow/WSAD camera movement, edge scrolling, and many others.[/p][p][/p][p]All these changes are now available to test via [b]Steam Playtest[/b].[/p][p]Any feedback is much appreciated! 💛[/p]

notes.title: The Tiny Teams 2025 festival has just ended - thank you all!
notes.content:
[p]First of all, we’d like to [b]welcome all the new members of our community[/b] <3[b]

[/b]The [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteams2025"]Tiny Teams 2025[/url] festival has just ended and it was quite a ride!
[b]
[/b]We’re proud to share that over [b]5,000[/b] people played our demo during the festival!
Additionally, more than [b]400[/b] people filled out our survey!

Below, you can find some of the survey results. Today is a holiday in Poland, but starting Monday, we’re back to work - and we’ll be sharing our game progress with you :)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Take care and have a great weekend![/b] <3

notes.title: 🎉 We’re thrilled to share the demo of Poof! Cleaning Services with you!
notes.content: [p]After many months of hard work, cozy design, and bug-squashing, the game is finally ready for you to try out. We’re incredibly proud to be part of the [b]Tiny Teams Festival[/b], a celebration of games made by small teams and solo developers, and we’re honored to stand among so many creative and heartfelt projects.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025[/url][/p][p]✨ [i]Poof! Cleaning Services[/i] is a cozy game about tidying up messy rooms, uncovering little stories, and connecting with people through the items they leave behind. We hope it brings you warmth, joy, and maybe a few surprises.[/p][p]🧽 Please give the demo a try, share your thoughts, and help us make it even better. Your feedback truly means the world to our tiny team![/p][p]Thank you for being here 💛[/p]

notes.title: A new playtest starts today!
notes.content: [p]Hi guys![/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’ve started [b]a new round of playtesting[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t had the chance to try the game yet, or you want to see what’s new, now’s the perfect opportunity![/p][p]We’ve added some features and made lots of tweaks based on your feedback from the last playtest.[/p][p]And yes, we’ve also added the most requested feature from the previous round: [b]zooming[/b]![/p][p]We can’t wait to hear what you think 😊[/p][p][/p][p][b]The playtest will last only 5 days (until Sunday, July 27th)[/b], so please don’t wait too long![/p][p][/p][p]Have fun! 💛[/p]
